purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/API routes, bounded anonymous access review, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Punjab's official BhuNaksha viewer is publicly reachable and its current JavaScript/configuration was inspected. Anonymous hierarchy calls resolved Bathinda district 04 and tehsil 039, and extent calls returned projected map bounds and a composite gisCode for two Bathinda-tehsil villages. Exact-point plot-identification calls returned empty bodies for both tested extents because the WUP point was outside those bounded village extents. No parcel polygon or safe native ID is retained.
registryAssessment: A local/state cadastral map service is directly evidenced by the Punjab Government BhuNaksha viewer and Bathinda-specific DILRMP status page; registryFound is true for service existence, while geometry integration remains unverified.
safeFieldAllowlist: safe parcel identifier only if publicly exposed and non-personal
